signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Pick up your diary, favourites and series.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: Log what you watch, rate it, and keep one diary on all your devices.
signUp.hint: By signing up you agree that your data is stored in your account.

confirm.title: Almost there
confirm.subtitle: Your account has been created.
confirm.cardDescription: Open the link we sent to your email, then sign in.

prompt.title: An account is needed
prompt.description: You need an account to save this. Signing up takes a minute.

signOut.failed: Your changes haven’t uploaded yet. Connect to the internet and try again.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong.
errors.already_registered: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password: The password is too weak. Make it longer.
errors.shortPassword: The password must be at least 6 characters.
errors.invalidUsername: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.same_password: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.invalidCode: Enter the code from the email.
errors.email_send_failed: The email could not be sent. Check the SMTP settings in Supabase.
errors.needs_recent_sign_in: For security, sign out and back in, then try again.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a one-time code.
forgot.codeSubtitle: We sent a code to {{email}}. Check spam if it isn't there.
forgot.resent: A new code is on its way.

chooseUsername.title: Choose a username
chooseUsername.subtitle: It shows on your profile with an @, and friends will find you by it.
chooseUsername.hint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores. You can change it later in “Edit profile”.
